title: Zero-Density Concentration for Dirichlet Polynomials
summary: We prove that broad families of finite Dirichlet sums exhibit deterministic concentration of normalized vertical zero density on a single line. The main result gives a general criterion under which the normalized Jessen potentials converge locally uniformly to a piecewise-linear convex function with a single corner. The associated normalized measures describing the distribution of real parts of zeros in vertical mean density then converge weakly to a Dirac mass.
